componentDescription: The link that opens a preview card on hover or focus.

closeDelay.description: How long to wait before closing the preview card. Specified in milliseconds.

delay.description: How long to wait before the preview card opens. Specified in milliseconds.

handle.description: A handle that connects the trigger with a PreviewCard rendered elsewhere. Create one with createPreviewCardHandle().

id.description: The id of the trigger. Pass it to triggerId on PreviewCard to open the card from this trigger.

payload.description: A payload to pass to the preview card when it is opened.

render.description: The element that opens the preview card, usually a link. Accepts an element or a function that receives the props and the Base UI state.
